tool_args.rationale: Use the documented three-parameter siphon base with an open square-root branch. The purchased probe supplies broad s_grad leverage, addressing the initial vmax–rho collinearity, and the observed lower-y response at high s_grad is consistent with the sink-gradient factor. Fit all target parameters numerically within the specified wide fallback bounds.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The added wide-s_grad measurements resolve the pilot collinearity; current horizon is not a long-horizon extrapolation requiring trajectory data.
Observed response increases monotonically over the sampled u range, unlike the documented high-u decline; the s_grad-dependent variation also supports the siphon mechanism.
Available measurements reach s_grad=2.35, below the documented supercritical gray-zone trigger (>2.36); no avalanche probe is indicated.
